exact_statement: For every Boolean g on n>=1 uniform independent inputs and every fixed L>=2, let h_L(x)=g(product of the L physical bits in block j : j=1..n). Its full squared Fourier spectrum is exactly ghat^2 on unions of whole blocks; H(h_L)=H(g), I(h_L)=L I(g), so uniform FEI on this class for any fixed L is full-FEI-equivalent up to factor L. At every physical restriction with at least one bit remaining in each block the full spectrum and any supplied finite calibrated core reference R, R(empty)=(Eg)^2, are pushed forward by the remaining-block injection; all reference-only atoms and full arbitrary-core CE survive. At every query whose block has at least two remaining bits, the spectral fiber contains at most one actual/reference image atom: BOTH child squared laws equal the marginalized parent law, physical query entropy decrement, conditional erasure, JS and conditional occupancy KL are zero. For ANY complementary disjoint controller A,B and BOTH actual tag children A+sigma B h_L with current coherent signed-vacuum reference, the FULL controller-vacuum-plus-tail calibration refund is also zero; the physical query influence is beta Inf_j(g). Every adaptive tree of depth D<L has this property at all internal queries, retaining the whole arbitrary core spectrum at every leaf. These are actual full-Boolean functions satisfying the complete convolution/derivative hierarchy, not fixed-prefix controls. This is a local-refund/bounded-lookahead obstruction, not an FEI disproof or a refutation of a genuinely unused ancestor bank.
